evidence: Modifies src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, and tests to add btck_witness_stack_to_bytes to the kernel C API.
rationale: Adds a missing convenience and performance serialization function to the kernel C API. The PR addresses the 'O(n²) cost of reading a whole witness with btck_witness_stack_get_item_at' by providing a single-call consensus byte serialization method.
